import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Convert year and month to a datetime column for better plotting
data['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Group by year and breed to count the number of registrations
breed_counts = data.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Filter for the top 5 most common breeds
top_breeds = breed_counts.groupby('Rasse1Text')['Count'].sum().nlargest(5).index
breed_counts_top = breed_counts[breed_counts['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=breed_counts_top, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='Count', hue='Rasse1Text', marker='o')

# Customizing the plot
plt.title('Top 5 Dog Breeds Registration Over Time in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Dog Breed')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

# Convert year and month to a datetime column for better plotting
data['Date'] = pd.to_datetime(data['StichtagDat'])

# Group by year and breed to count the number of registrations
breed_counts = data.groupby(['StichtagDatJahr', 'Rasse1Text']).size().reset_index(name='Count')

# Filter for the top 5 most common breeds
top_breeds = breed_counts.groupby('Rasse1Text')['Count'].sum().nlargest(5).index
breed_counts_top = breed_counts[breed_counts['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.lineplot(data=breed_counts_top, x='StichtagDatJahr', y='Count', hue='Rasse1Text', marker='o')
